title: "About"

I am Tanmay Chanda. I build R and Shiny applications, mostly for clinical
reporting.

I write here about the parts of that work that seem worth passing on: the
problems that were harder than they looked, and the reasons behind a
decision rather than only the decision.

My R packages:

- [rewind](https://github.com/tenmeh/rewind) - undo and redo for Shiny
  applications. On CRAN.

Find me on [GitHub](https://github.com/tenmeh).
